atoms.a: Hi Sophie! I hear we're long-distance neighbours. I'm from New Zealand.
atoms.b: Hi, Sophie! I hear we're long-distance neighbours. I’m from ((New_Zealand)).

atoms.a: I’m from Australia. Our countries are 1500 kilometres apart, so although there are many differences, there are also similarities, like English being the main language.
atoms.b: I’m from Australia. Our countries are 1500 kilometres apart, so although there are many differences, there are also similarities, like English being the main ((language)).

atoms.a: That's true. We both love sports and being outside, right? Rugby is very popular in New Zealand.
atoms.b: That's true. We both love sports and being outside, right? ((Rugby)) is very popular in New Zealand.

atoms.a: We like rugby too, but Australians also love cricket and Australian Football.
atoms.b: We like rugby too, but ((Australians)) also love cricket and Australian Football.

instruction.text: Was haben die beiden gemeinsam? Ziehe die richtigen Antworten nach unten.

atoms.a: What about the weather? Is Australia always hot?
atoms.b: What about the weather? Is Australia always ((hot))?

atoms.a: Not everywhere. Australia is huge, so the weather is very different from place to place. The north is usually warm, but the south can be quite cool in winter.
atoms.b: Not everywhere. Australia is ((huge)), so the weather is very different from place to place. The north is usually warm, but the south can be quite ((cool)) in winter.

atoms.a: New Zealand is smaller, and our weather can change very quickly. It can be sunny in the morning and rainy in the afternoon!
atoms.b: New Zealand is smaller, and our weather can change very quickly. It can be ((sunny)) in the morning and rainy in the afternoon!

atoms.a: I see. I'd love to visit one day! Then I could hopefully see the kiwi, your most famous animal.
atoms.b: I see. I'd love to visit one day! Then I could hopefully see the ((kiwi)), your most famous animal.

instruction.text: Was möchte Sophie in Neuseeland sehen?

atoms.a: We should visit each other! I would love to see the Great Barrier Reef and the deserts.
atoms.b: We should visit each other! I would love to see the Great Barrier Reef and the ((deserts)).

atoms.a: Then we should definitely visit each other's countries in the future to see the similarities and differences with our own eyes.
atoms.b: Then we should definitely ((visit)) each other's countries in the future to see the similarities and differences with our own eyes.
